we propose a novel approach to modelling dynamical systems of interacting objects, namely geometric graphs, by introducing local coordinate frames that are invariant to arbitrary translations and rotations of the global coordinate system, and demonstrate the approach to be superior to the current state-of-the-art.

(1) local coordinate frames are a natural and effective way to induce roto-translational invariance in geometric graph neural networks, (2) local coordinate frames can be used to naturally define anisotropic filtering, (3) our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in a wide range of tasks.
